name: anlide/hilos-demo-websocket-test
description: WebSocket test demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.install-deps: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local composer install
scripts.setup-env: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php -r "require 'vendor/autoload.php'; \Hilos\Utils\Env::init(); echo '.env file initialized.';"
scripts.daemon-status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.migration:up: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:up
scripts.migration:down: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:down
scripts.migration:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:status
scripts.migration:retry: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php migration:retry
scripts.db:schema:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.db:entity:diff: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:diff
scripts.db:entity:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:fix
scripts.db:entity:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:entity:fix --dry-run
scripts.db:object:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:object:fix
scripts.db:object:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:object:fix --dry-run
scripts.db:idea:fix: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:idea:fix
scripts.db:idea:fix-dry-run: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:idea:fix --dry-run
scripts.pma: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d phpmyadmin-local && echo phpMyAdmin is running at http://localhost:8080
scripts.frontend-install: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-frontend-local npm install
scripts.frontend-build: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm websocket-test-frontend-local npm run build
